name: Ryoujoku Shinpan Mahou Shoujo Sumire & Daisy ~Torawareta Seishoujo~
original_name: 凌辱審判 魔法少女すみれ＆デイジー ～囚われた聖少女～
source:
The magical girls, Sumire and Daisy belonged to church, protecting the world peace.

People called them “glorious young ladies” as the girls were so sincere, pure and beautiful.

Their duty this time was to rescue the young girl who was imprisoned by the crazed church members.

However, that was a very clever trick on them…
